# The same two-owner deposit, but written as a payment GnuCash made for Alpha:
# `txn_type: P` with `owner:` puts Alpha on the *transaction*, while both
# receivable splits are in no lot and so name nobody themselves.
#
# Whichever of the two a bare `txn_guid:` block moves is not decided by
# anything here, so Beta's invoice naming this transaction must not be refused
# on the strength of the owner written across the whole of it.
customer "C-TWO-A"
	name: "Alpha"
	currency: CAD

customer "C-TWO-B"
	name: "Beta"
	currency: CAD

2026-05-15 * "Deposit covering Alpha and Beta"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	txn_type: P
	owner: customer:C-TWO-A
	Assets:Bank 220.00 CAD
	Assets:Accounts Receivable -100.00 CAD
	Assets:Accounts Receivable -120.00 CAD
